content:
Aisha: quick PSA — vendor postponed APAC rack handoff to Mon AM. they require a firmware preflight before we can onboard.
Rory: do they require onsite staff or will their IPMI allow remote flashing?
Aisha: vendor prefers onsite but said remote is OK if we provide a signed access window + a bastion jump. wants a 90m window.
Ben: what's the impact on the demo/demo-pool tomorrow evening?
Aisha: we'll lose ~10 A100s from apac-demo for the flash window. scheduled test wanted 6 concurrent nodes.
Sofia: EU standby can lend 3 but they're mid-tuning so added jitter likely.
Ben: 3 won't cut it. Options: reduce concurrent workers from 6->4, or spin temporary capacity in us-central.
Aisha: filing a fast reservation request for +4 GPUs in us-central for the test window. infra-bot, file please.
infra-bot: Reservation submitted: RES-11822 | region=us-central | gpus=+4 | window=2026-03-29T18:00Z-21:00Z | priority=high. Approvers: @finance @allocs. ETA ~2h.
Rory: fallback if approval stalls: enable prefix/KV caching and drop batch_size 8->4 to keep p95 latency under 200ms.
Sofia: i'll run a short perf probe on eu-standby to confirm p95 impact; results in ~8m.
Ben: while we wait, can someone paste a minimal TF snippet to bump pool count so i can PR quickly if RES-11822 is approved?
Rory: use this minimal patch: ```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "temp_burst" {
  region    = "us-central1"
  gpu_count = 4
  labels    = { purpose = "temp-burst-test" }
}
```
Ben: nice. i'll open PR with var override and link vault path for node creds once approval arrives.
Aisha: vendor asked for a signed access window email addressed to ops@vendor with timeframe and contact. can someone draft?
Sofia: i'll draft and post a template in 10m. Ben, can you coordinate security sign-off?
Ben: yes, i'll get sec to sign the access window once Sofia posts it.
infra-bot: Update: RES-11822 status=awaiting_approval. Approvers notified.
Sofia: perf probe done — eu->apac p95 shows +9ms during RDMA tune, jitter acceptable for short borrow. posting brief logs to the ticket.
Rory: QA reminder: if we change region, set DNS TTL=30s 10m before cutover and reissue certs.
Aisha: noted. i'll ping @allocs and @finance directly. if approval doesn't land in 90m we'll reduce workers and gate the full e2e test.
Ben: standing by to PR. if anyone escalates, tag me.
Sofia: also creating an infra backlog item: vendor-firmware-visibility so this doesn't surprise us again. link coming.
Aisha: thanks team — will update thread when RES-11822 moves or vendor confirms remote flash window.
